questions.question: 1. Which of the following is a prefix of the word 'ABRACADABRA'?

explanations.a: Incorrect. CADABRA is a suffix of 'ABRACADABRA', not a prefix. A prefix starts from the beginning of the word.
explanations.b: Correct. ABRA is a prefix of 'ABRACADABRA' as it appears at the beginning of the word.
explanations.c: Incorrect. ABARD is not a prefix of 'ABRACADABRA' as the letters do not match the beginning sequence.
explanations.d: Incorrect. ABRACAD is a prefix of 'ABRACADABRA', but option b is also correct and was marked as the answer.

questions.question: 2. How many parents can each node (not the Root) of a Tree of Size N can have?

explanations.a: Incorrect. In a tree structure, each non-root node has exactly one parent, not N-1 parents.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Trees do not allow multiple parents for a single node. If multiple parents were allowed, it would be a graph, not a tree.
explanations.c: Correct. By definition, in a tree data structure, each node (except the root) has exactly one parent node.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Only the root node has 0 parents. All other nodes must have exactly 1 parent.

questions.question: 3. How many parents does the root of a tree of size N can have?

explanations.a: Incorrect. The root node is the topmost node in a tree and has no parent.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The root node cannot have any parents, regardless of the tree size.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The root node by definition has no parent. If it had a parent, it wouldn't be the root.
explanations.d: Correct. The root of a tree has 0 parents. It is the starting node of the tree and has no parent node.

questions.question:
4. int a = 0, b = 0;
for (i = 0; i < N; i++) {
a = a + rand();
}
for (j = 0; j < M; j++) {
b = b + rand();
}
What is the time and space complexity for the above code?

answers.b: O(N + M) time, O(N + M) space
answers.d: O(N * M) time, O(N + M) space

explanations.a: Incorrect. The loops are sequential, not nested, so time complexity is O(N + M), not O(N * M).
explanations.b: Incorrect. While the time complexity O(N + M) is correct, the space complexity is O(1) as only two variables are used regardless of input size.
explanations.c: Correct. The two loops run sequentially (not nested), giving O(N + M) time complexity. Only constant space is used for variables a and b, giving O(1) space complexity.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Both complexities are wrong. The loops are sequential (not nested) and only constant space is used.
